income_guide_sections.title: 1) Basic Salary
income_guide_sections.content: The company employs a cumulative sign-in mechanism as part of its salary distribution structure, designed to encourage users to complete their daily missions consistently. Although the basic salary amount is fixed, it is not paid as a lump sum. Instead, the salary is released after a designated number of working days, such as 2 days, 4 days, or 7 days, to encourage consistent daily mission completion. Once users complete the required number of working days, the company will pay them accordingly.

income_guide_sections.title: 2) Reset Bonus
income_guide_sections.content:
The Reset Bonus serves as one of the most significant sources of income when you first begin working with us. Each user may complete two sets of missions per day, and merchants provide additional Reset Bonuses to encourage consistent mission completion.

Under the reset incentive structure:

  1. You will receive an additional 10 USD bonus each time you reset your account to begin the first mission with 100 USD.
  2. When your total reset amount exceeds 1,500 USD in a single day, you will receive an extra 4% bonus based on the cumulative reset amount for the two sets completed that day.

resetBonusScheme.title: Salary Scheme
resetBonusScheme.subtitle: Sign In . Show Up . Get Paid

income_guide_sections.title: 3) Daily Profits
income_guide_sections.content:
Daily profits represent your main income stream. The system assigns products from various merchants for Enhancement based on your current account balance. For each product you optimize, you will earn 0.5% to 2.5% of the product price as profit.

Profit levels are determined by your VIP tier—the higher your VIP level, the higher your profit rate. Additionally, the number of missions per set increases as your VIP level advances.

Some merchants also provide combination products. The system may randomly assign these combination products to users according to their account balance. Depending on the product types you optimize, you may earn an additional 5% to 25% in profit.

clause_sections.title: Account Enhancement and Reset
clause_sections.content:
1.1 Users must complete all rating mission with a minimum participation amount of 50 USD and maintain a minimum account reset amount of 100 USD.

1.2 After completing each set of missions, users must contact customer service to request an account reset before starting the next set.

clause_sections.title: Withdrawals and Fund Security
clause_sections.content:
2.1 Users must complete all enhancement missions before becoming eligible for withdrawal.

2.2 To prevent potential fund loss, all withdrawals are processed automatically by the system and cannot be handled manually.

2.3 Users are not permitted to request withdrawals during an ongoing mission to avoid disruptions to merchant operations.

2.4 User funds are securely protected on the platform, and the platform will be liable for any accidental loss caused by system issues.

clause_sections.title: Account and Password Security
clause_sections.content:
3.1 Users must not disclose their account login password or withdrawal password to anyone.

3.2 Users are responsible for keeping their account information confidential.

3.3 The platform will not be responsible for any losses caused by accidental disclosure of account credentials.

3.4 Users are advised not to use easily guessable passwords (e.g., birthdays, ID numbers, phone numbers). Strong passwords are recommended for fund protection.

3.5 If a user forgets their password, they may reset it by contacting online customer service and must update it afterwards.

clause_sections.title: Mission Product Assignment
clause_sections.content:
4.1 All products or mission within missions are automatically and randomly assigned by the system and cannot be modified, canceled, controlled, or skipped.

4.2 Due to the large number of users, the platform does not manually assign product combinations. All product data are distributed randomly by the system.

clause_sections.title: Misuse of Accounts
clause_sections.content: Legal action will be taken against any misuse or fraudulent activity involving user accounts.

clause_sections.title: Advance Requirements
clause_sections.content: Each product within a mission may come from a different merchant. No advance may remain pending for more than 10 minutes, and each advance must be confirmed with online service to verify the merchant’s details.

clause_sections.title: Incorrect Advance Information
clause_sections.content: The platform is not responsible for any losses caused by advance made to incorrect or unverified account details.

clause_sections.title: Completion Time Requirements
clause_sections.content: Each set of enhancement mission must be completed within 24 hours. Failure to do so may result in merchant complaints, and users will bear any resulting breach-of-contract liabilities.

clause_sections.title: Credit Score Deduction
clause_sections.content: If a merchant files a complaint, the system will deduct the user’s credit score. Accounts with a credit score below 98 are not eligible for withdrawal. The system will automatically recalculate the credit score after each completed set of missions.

faq_sections.title: Product Enhancement mission
faq_sections.content:
1.1 A minimum account balance of USD 50 is required to initiate the first set of 40 missions.

1.2 A minimum renewal advance of USD 100 is required to begin a new set of missions.

1.3 Users must complete all assigned missions before submitting any withdrawal request.

faq_sections.title: Withdrawals
faq_sections.content:
2.1 Users must complete all missions before being eligible to request a withdrawal.

2.2 If a user chooses to abandon or exit an ongoing mission enhancement, no withdrawal or refund request will be accepted.

2.3 Withdrawals cannot be processed unless a valid withdrawal request has been submitted.

2.4 The maximum withdrawal amount for VIP1 users is USD 10,000, and USD 30,000 for VIP2 users. VIP3 and above have no maximum withdrawal limit.

2.5 To ensure faster and more secure service, accounts with balances exceeding USD 60,000 are required to use the platform’s high-volume withdrawal channel, which enables a one-time full withdrawal of all funds.

2.6 Accounts with insufficient credit scores may be restricted from accessing certain platform features.

faq_sections.title: Funds
faq_sections.content:
3.1 All funds are securely held in the user’s account and may be withdrawn in full once all relevant data mission have been completed.

3.2 To prevent any financial discrepancies, all data processing is conducted automatically by the system and not manually.

3.3 The platform assumes full responsibility for any accidental loss of user funds.

3.4 If a user’s funds exceed the government’s taxable threshold, the user is responsible for paying all applicable taxes.

faq_sections.title: Account Security
faq_sections.content:
4.1 Users must not disclose their login or withdrawal passwords to any third party. The platform is not liable for any losses resulting from unauthorized disclosure.

4.2 Users are strongly advised not to use birthdays, ID numbers, or mobile phone numbers as login or withdrawal passwords.

4.3 If a user forgets their login or withdrawal password, please contact our online customer service team for a password reset.

faq_sections.title: General Product Data
faq_sections.content:
5.1 Platform profit categories include normal product data profit and 10× combination product data profit.

5.2 Normal users earn 0.5% profit for each completed normal enhancement mission.

5.3 VIP2 users earn 1% profit for each completed normal enhancement mission.

5.4 VIP3 users earn 1.5% profit for each completed normal enhancement mission.

5.5 VIP4 users earn 2% profit for each completed normal enhancement mission.

5.6 VIP5 users earn 2.5% profit for each completed normal enhancement mission.

5.7 Funds and profits are automatically credited back to the user’s account after each mission is completed.

5.8 Mission are randomly assigned by the system based on the user’s total account balance.

5.9 Once a product enhancement mission is assigned to a user, it cannot be cancelled or skipped.

faq_sections.title: Combination Product Data
faq_sections.content:
6.1 Combination product data consists of 1 to 3 items. Users may not always receive all 3 items; mission are randomly assigned, with a higher likelihood of receiving 1 or 2 items.

6.2 Users earn 10× the profit from combination product data compared to normal product data.

6.3 Upon receiving combination product data, all rolling funds will pause and will be returned to the user’s account once all items in the combination are completed.

6.4 Combination product data is assigned randomly based on the total balance in the user’s account.

6.5 Once assigned, combination product data cannot be cancelled or skipped.

faq_sections.title: Advance
faq_sections.content:
7.1 The advance amount is determined solely by the user. The platform does not set advance amounts and recommends that users advance according to their financial capability or after becoming familiar with the platform.

7.2 If a advance is needed for combination product data, the user is advised to advance the amount corresponding to the insufficiency shown on the account.

7.3 Before making any advance, users must contact online customer service to request and confirm the advance details.

7.4 The platform will not be responsible for any losses resulting from advance made using incorrect advance details.

terms_p3: 2) User withdrawals and system withdrawal requirements / security of user funds.
terms_p4: 2.1) Each user needs to complete all optimization missions before they can meet the system withdrawal requirements.
terms_p5: 2.2) To avoid any loss of funds, all withdrawals are processed automatically by the system and not manually.
terms_p6: 2.3) Users are not allowed to apply for withdrawal in the middle of a mission to avoid affecting merchant operations.
terms_p7: 2.4) Users’ funds are completely safe on the platform and the platform will be liable for any accidental loss.
terms_p8: 3) Please do not disclose your account password and withdrawal password to others. The platform will not be held responsible for any loss or damage caused.
terms_p9: 3.1) All users are advised to keep their accounts secure to avoid disclosure.
terms_p10: 3.2) The platform is not responsible for any accidental disclosure of accounts.

faq_mission_2: 1.2) A minimum renewal of 100 USD is required to start the new missions.

faq_withdraw_1: 2.1) Users need to complete the missions before they can request a withdrawal.
faq_withdraw_2: 2.2) You cannot request a withdrawal or refund if you choose to give up or withdraw in the middle of a mission optimization.

faq_withdraw_4: 2.4) The maximum withdrawal amount for VIP1 users is 10,000 USD, for VIP2 users it is 30,000 USD. There is no maximum withdrawal limit for VIP3 and above.
